meta.token_rule: runs of letters in any alphabet, an inner apostrophe or hyphen kept, lowercased, a possessive 's removed; digits and punctuation dropped
meta.sentences: paragraphs split at line breaks, then spaCy's rule-based sentencizer
meta.score: MATTR over a sliding window, z-scored against the pages nearest in length
